postal-code-centric examples; low value for the five starting countries compared with OSM and OpenAddresses
format: gzipped TSV, three columns: language (ISO 639-1), country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 lowercase), tagged address. The address column is space-separated token/label pairs, for example 'Parkstraße/road 8/house_number |/FSEP 6OG/level'; '|/FSEP' marks a field separator and ',/SEP' a separator token. Verified by streaming the first bytes of the 20170304 file on 2026-09-22.
